candidate_relations.reason: The record demonstrates Strongyloides larvae in the respiratory tract with gastrointestinal and pulmonary involvement during immunosuppression, plus Aspergillus-positive bronchoalveolar lavage. CKD-associated intestinal dysmotility does not represent the required disseminated Strongyloides and Aspergillus coinfection.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Noninfectious gastrointestinal syndrome attributed to chronic kidney disease; omits disseminated strongyloidiasis and concurrent aspergillosis.
